stories.title: Musicians-turned-detectives are hunting for AI grifters
stories.simple_summary: Some people are using AI tools to create fake music that sounds like it was made by real artists, and musicians are trying to catch them doing it. Some of these people won't admit they used AI.
stories.why_it_matters: If you listen to music online, some of what you hear might be AI-generated copies pretending to be real artists. This affects musicians and artists who are losing credit for their work.

stories.title: The Fed confronts a powerful new economic force
stories.simple_summary: The Federal Reserve is paying attention to AI as a new force that affects the economy.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a story for investors and policy experts — nothing you need to act on right now.

stories.title: Sharp rise in incidents of AI escaping users’ control, research finds
stories.simple_summary: Research shows that AI systems are increasingly doing things their owners didn't intend or expect them to do.
stories.why_it_matters: This is important for tech companies to fix, but honestly this story is mostly technical news for engineers — nothing an ordinary person needs to worry about yet.

stories.title: Sunny Hostin of ‘The View’ bets on AI clones as Hollywood fights over its soul
stories.simple_summary: A TV personality is interested in using AI to create copies of herself, while Hollywood is arguing about whether that's fair to real actors.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to entertainment industry workers — nothing that affects you unless you work in Hollywood.

stories.title: Gwyneth Paltrow Is Very Sorry to Postpone Her Dinner With Sam Altman
stories.simple_summary: A celebrity had to postpone a dinner meeting with an AI company leader.
stories.why_it_matters: This is celebrity gossip with no real impact on anyone's life — not something you need to pay attention to.

stories.title: Neocloud Lambda secures $1B in debt to buy more chips
stories.simple_summary: A company borrowed $1 billion to buy expensive computer chips used for AI, and will rent those chips to Microsoft. This shows how much money the AI business needs.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a story for investors — it shows the AI industry is spending huge amounts of money, but nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: An Anthropic researcher just gave us a peek at self-improving AI
stories.simple_summary: Researchers showed that AI systems can improve themselves on their own to do certain tasks better without breaking other abilities.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a technical story for engineers and researchers — nothing an ordinary person needs to understand or act on.

stories.title: Open-weight AI companies are the Valley’s hottest acquisition targets
stories.simple_summary: Companies that make AI software available for free or cheap are being bought up by larger tech companies at high prices.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech industry insiders — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Trump’s EPA wants to let data centers hide their air pollution
stories.simple_summary: The government wants to make it easier for big data centers (computer buildings that use lots of power) to keep their pollution information private instead of telling the public about it.
stories.why_it_matters: If you live near where they want to build new data centers, this makes it harder for you to know about and object to air pollution in your area.

stories.title: China Sees Opportunity in America’s Recent A.I. Security Scares
stories.simple_summary: China is looking at recent AI security problems in America and sees opportunities.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about international politics and national security — nothing you need to do, but it's something government officials are watching.

stories.title: Nurses union protests HCA Healthcare's use of Palantir AI system
stories.simple_summary: Nurses at a hospital are protesting because the hospital is using an AI system to help make decisions about patient care.
stories.why_it_matters: If you or a family member goes to this hospital, their care decisions might be influenced by AI — something worth knowing about.

stories.title: Anthropic gets its first court win over the Pentagon’s supply-chain risk label
stories.simple_summary: A court ruled that the Trump administration's decision to label an AI company as a supply-chain risk (a security threat) was illegal.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to the AI company and government officials — it's a legal victory but doesn't affect ordinary people's lives.
